title: The structure of constitutive activity is geometric

statements.text: The relations among the projections are dimensional rather than logical, so they cannot be conjoined as independent propositions. Geometric means structural-dimensional in an abstract sense, not a shape in three-dimensional space, and not a Platonist mathematical object that activity instantiates.

sources.quote: The second commitment is that the structure of constitutive activity is geometric, not propositional.
Geometric here does not mean spatial in the literal three-dimensional sense.
